text.p01: To those who build stuff like Venny & Sammy A story about Teamwork.
text.p03: In a peaceful forest, by the edge of a wide, rushing river, lived a beaver named Venny and a squirrel named Sammy.
text.p04: One day, Venny and Sammy spotted the biggest, juiciest strawberry bush on the other side of the river
text.p05: “Let’s build a bridge!” Venny said excitedly. “Yes!” Sammy agreed.
text.p06: “We should build it with strong logs,” Venny said, tapping his thick tail. “It needs to be sturdy.”
text.p07: “No, no!” Sammy squeaked. “We should use light branches so it’s quick and easy!
text.p08: As usual they both had different ideas. They argued and argued until finally,
text.p09: they decided to build separate bridges their own way.
text.p10: Venny gathered heavy logs and built his bridge.
text.p11: But the logs were too big and float away into the river with a big splash!
text.p12: Sammy used light branches to build his bridge.
text.p13: But the branches were too flimsy, and his bridge wobbled and collapsed with a loud crack!
text.p14: They both sat by the river, wet and frustrated.
text.p15: “Your idea didn’t work!” Sammy huffed. “Well, neither did yours!” Venny grumbled.
text.p16: After a moment, Sammy sighed. “Maybe… we should try working together?”
text.p17: Venny thought for a second and nodded. “Yeah, maybe combining our ideas is the best way.”
text.p18: “Your logs are really strong,” Sammy admitted. “But they’re too heavy on their own.”
text.p19: Venny scratched his head. “And your branches are light and flexible, but too weak to hold everything up.”
text.p20: Sammy’s eyes lit up. “What if we use my soft branches to tie your big logs together?”
text.p21: Venny grinned. “That might actually work! The logs will be sturdy, and the branches will keep them from floating away.”
text.p22: So, they got to work. Venny brought strong logs
text.p23: and Sammy tied them together with flexible branches.
text.p24: They laughed and cheered as they worked,
text.p25: realizing how much faster and better it was when they helped each other.
text.p26: By the end of the day, they had built the sturdiest, most beautiful bridge the forest had ever seen
text.p27: Together, Venny and Sammy crossed the bridge, excited to reach the strawberry bush.
text.p28: As they munched on the juicy strawberries, Sammy smiled. “We did it!”
text.p29: Venny grinned. “Yep! Together, we can do more.”
text.p30: From that day on, Venny and Sammy became the best of friends
text.p31: knowing that teamwork made everything better —and a lot more fun!
